name: quicksilver-grail-banishes-itself-as-the-cost-and-plays-the-banished-card
notes: Quicksilver Grail: On Enter banishes a material card face down; 'Banish CARDNAME' (a cost) lets you play it. Pre-fix the Grail was never banished and could be reused indefinitely.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: You may play the banished card. (You still pay for its costs.)

engineBug.summary: FIXED. 'Banish CARDNAME' is the ability's cost but nothing paid it (no GAFieldAbilityCostTable() entry): the Grail stayed on the field and the ability was repeatable. Added the spec.
